items.headline: Venables lauds Witten after Sooners shine in Oklahoma playcaller's debut
items.description: In his debut as Oklahoma's offensive playcaller, Jason Witten, a former NFL tight end who coached high school in Texas last year, engineered an impressive Sooners attack that throttled No. 25 Florida in a 23-7 victory Saturday to push them to 5-4.
